verdict: Provide one editable Preparation tab with saved applications, position/preparation title, company or platform, optional skill focus and requirements. Keep architecture/product, coding/refactoring and Outlier skill preparation as local starter data; select architecture/product initially. Use requirements as context, not proof of expertise.
why: The user wants to enter the application context themselves and keep language-specific preparation simple.

decided.quote: English translation: I should be able to enter the position and provider myself in a Preparation tab. Outlier language-specific screenings could also be a preset; do not make it too complicated.
